subject: Network Theory
questionText:
The figure shows the per-phase equivalent circuit of 
a two-pole three-phase induction motor operating at 
50Hz. The “air-gap” voltage, Vg across the 
magnetizing inductance, is 210Vrms, and the slip s, 
is 0.05. The torque (in Nm) produced by the motor is 
_______.
explanation: Practice Question from Network Theory DPP-27 (Sinusoidal Steady State Analysis).
